name: rapidfuzz
description: Fuzzy string matching and edit-distance for DuckDB, powered by the RapidFuzz C++ library. Five ratio variants for record matching plus eight distance/similarity algorithms (Jaro, Jaro-Winkler, Hamming, Indel, Levenshtein/OSA, LCS, prefix/postfix) — every one in distance, similarity, and normalized forms.

cta.title: High-Performance Fuzzy Matching
cta.description: Install RapidFuzz for record linkage, dedupe, spell-check, and similarity ranking — Jaro/Jaro-Winkler, Levenshtein, LCS, and the full token_*_ratio family from the Python rapidfuzz library.

quickStart.title: Pick best match per row
quickStart.sql:
SELECT a.id, b.id,
       rapidfuzz_ratio(a.name, b.name) AS score
FROM left_records a, right_records b
WHERE rapidfuzz_ratio(a.name, b.name) > 85
ORDER BY a.id, score DESC;
